sections.content:
# 6. Technical Solution & Architecture

## 6.1 Solution Overview
The technical solution is designed to support the target users:
- **Target Users:** Founder\nProduct engineer\nAI builder operator

It addresses the core workflow requirements through a highly structured, scalable software architecture.


## 6.2 Technical Architecture
The system employs the following architectural blueprint:
- **Default Stack:** Node.js (v22 LTS), TypeScript (v5+), Express (v4+), simple-git, firebase-admin, Zod Validation
- **Architecture Style:** Model-View-Controller API pattern with persistent artifact stores.
- **Scalability Model:** Stateless API server design to support rapid containerized horizontal scaling.


## 6.3 Functional & Non-functional Requirements

### Functional Requirements
- Automation of Users complete structured intake, genera...
- Real-time diagnostic health scoring dashboard
- Encrypted data store with strict tenant isolation
- Audit log generation on all system state modifications

### Non-functional Requirements
- API response latency under 500ms for 95% of operations
- Strict HTTPS TLS 1.3 transit security encryption
- TypeScript type-safety checking on 100% of compile targets

2. **Builder Phase:** Translates blueprints into software commits, with strict boundary constraints and zero-hallucination execution.
